title: We covered the forest's loudest singers
storyboard: Film: 4 nature-club kids at a mic copying a peacock call and an elephant rumble, then laughing; 2 takes
caption:
Our nature club tried covering two very different voices.

Elephant rumbles are infrasonic: other elephants can pick them up more than 3 km away, while we barely hear them.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo, Animal Diversity Web.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
